hypotheses.reasoning: A malformed message, msg-185456 (partition 2, offset 161402), contains a NUL byte that makes the JSON parse fail. The consumer nacks it and it gets redelivered over and over (attempt 6, then 15, then 23) because no max-retries is configured. That blocks partition 2, so lag climbs from 46s to 344s (4348 messages behind). CPU stays normal because the worker is only spinning on one message. The search-api 'timed out waiting for downstream confirmation' errors come after this and are a downstream symptom. catalog-svc, catalog-db and redis all look healthy, and there was no deploy.

verdict.recommendedAction: Move msg-185456 (partition 2, offset 161402) to a dead-letter queue or skip it so partition 2 starts moving again. Set a max-retries limit with DLQ routing on index-worker. Then find out how the producer wrote a message containing a NUL byte.
